lines: Don't leave me alone in the Bamboo Jungle. Everything rustles like it is sneaking up on me.
The Bamboo Jungle is too dense to lose sight of you in. I could barely tell which way was safe.
I was stuck in the Bamboo Jungle listening to every stalk creak and every branch snap.
If you disappear in a Bamboo Jungle, all I have left is noise and bad guesses.
The bamboo kept moving, and I could not tell what was wind and what was trouble.
Every direction looked the same once you were gone.
Please do not leave me somewhere that can hide you after three steps.
The Bamboo Jungle made every little sound feel too close.
I kept trying to see through the stalks, but the jungle was better at hiding things than I was at finding them.
I was alone in all that green noise, hoping the next rustle was you coming back.
I held my ground by the split bamboo stalks because the thicket closed behind you like a wall.
I followed as far as I could, then fallen bamboo made every track look the same.
Alone in Bamboo Jungle, every patch of water and brush looked like the place where we had split up.
I waited in a small opening between the stalks and listened for your steps.
